therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: immune checkpoint blockade combined with electric field disruption of cell division
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and tumor cell mitotic disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: first line advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer

results.dose_information: TTFields delivered at least 18 hours daily at 150 kHz; Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks

context.investigator_commentary: Phase 2 study terminated due to insufficient enrollment and was not based on safety concerns. Novocure is enrolling a new Phase 3 study of TTFields as a first line treatment for advanced/metastatic NSCLC (NCT06216301).
